[IARC.6.2] Each handle of [IARC.6.1], and the stream event, is owned by
exactly one module:

| Type                  | Owning module | Lifetime |
|-----------------------|---------------|----------|
| `ds_engine_t`         | `engine`      | Integrator creates / destroys. One handle = one Rete network; multiple coexist independently. |
| `ds_fact_t`           | `wm`          | Lives in working memory; retracted on TTL / truth-maint. |
| `ds_schema_t`         | `schema`      | Engine-lifetime once registered; freed on registry destroy. |
| `ds_stream_ev_t`      | `recorder`    | Caller-stack value during the stream callback only. |
| `ds_json_t`           | `json`        | Caller-owned tree; released via `ds_json_free`. |
